dct_description_sm: To expand the geographic coverage of the air monitoring program by developing, installing and operating passive air sampling devices capable of operating remotely under extreme conditions at up to 7 new locations across all Arctic regions. To provide spatially-distributed concentration data for this under-represented region to atmospheric modellers, to assist in model validation and improvement. Separate devices will be deployed for persistent organic pollutants (POPs) and mercury.
dct_subject_sm: Health sciences and contaminants -> Persistent organic pollutants (POPs)
dct_title_s: Passive Air Sampling Network for Organic Pollutants and Mercury
